title: Citrusy Guanciale Dolmades
description: A twist on traditional dolmades with the addition of crispy guanciale and a squeeze of citrus.
instructions: Wrap each dolmade in a piece of rice, leaving a small opening at the top.
Place the stuffed dolmades on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Meanwhile, cook the guanciale in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
Remove from heat and set aside.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the dolmades and sprinkle with parsley.
Top each dolmade with a piece of crispy guanciale.
